title: Trade Surplus Falls
subtitle: Forecast of trade surplus in 2026 is reduced
excerpt: Trade surplus forecast falls to US$ 84.4 billion
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The forecast for the trade surplus in 2026 has been reduced. The government revised its forecast, lowering it from US$ 90 billion to US$ 84.4 billion.

The drop in oil price projections was the factor that led to this reduction in the forecast of Brazil's trade balance surplus.

This revision signals a shift in economic expectations for 2026, reflecting the volatility of oil prices in the global market.

With information from Agência Brasil.
